title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention now covers Microsoft Cowork
summary: The briefing's rollout facts, policy controls and licensing statements are supported by the current Microsoft sources. One minor correction remains: the cost rationale should use the listed plan names rather than describing all eligible plans as E5-tier.

claims.quote: "id": 570845, "title": "Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork"

claims.claim: The roadmap status is Launched.
claims.quote: "status": "Launched", "statusKey": "launched"

claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Scope: Who and what
claims.claim: The integration enables a single DLP policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork.
claims.quote: enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes preventing the use of labelled knowledge sources.
claims.quote: preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources

claims.claim: The roadmap describes blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types.
claims.quote: blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types

claims.claim: The roadmap describes restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.
claims.quote: restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Existing Copilot DLP policies automatically apply to Cowork, supporting defaultState on for this extension.
claims.quote: Existing DLP policies that target the Microsoft Copilot workload will automatically apply to Microsoft Cowork.

claims.claim: New DLP policies created for Copilot automatically include Cowork.
claims.quote: New DLP policies created for Microsoft Copilot will automatically include Microsoft Cowork.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No separate configuration is required to extend existing Copilot DLP coverage to Cowork.
claims.quote: No separate configuration is required to extend existing Microsoft Copilot DLP coverage to Microsoft Cowork.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope: Who and what; controls[0].governs
claims.claim: Learn names the combined policy location Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location supports the following conditions and actions:

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The notice limits prompt DLP and web-search DLP to prompt text, not uploaded files at this time.
claims.quote: Note that Prompt DLP and Web Search DLP applies to the prompt text only, not uploaded files at this time.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope; Governance guidance; Open questions; rationale
claims.claim: Blocking external email is not yet supported for Cowork.
claims.quote: Blocking external email isn't yet supported for Cowork.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope; Governance guidance; Open questions; rationale
claims.claim: Customising the Learn about access restrictions link in policy tips is not yet supported for Cowork.
claims.quote: Customizing the link in Copilot policy tips isn't yet supported for Cowork.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope: Learn and the notice differ; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn marks SIT-based prompt blocking as preview and rolling out, including support for Cowork.
claims.quote: This feature is in preview and is rolling out to all tenants with access to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. Check whether rollout has reached your tenant. Cowork supports this feature

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Why it matters; Scope: Email and file coverage
claims.claim: Sensitivity-label rules prevent Copilot and Cowork from using matching file and email contents in responses.
claims.quote: Detects when a file or an email in Exchange has a chosen sensitivity label. Copilot and Cowork don't process the content of the item or use it in the response summary

claims.claim: Items excluded by sensitivity-label rules can still appear in response citations.
claims.quote: Identified items still appear in the citations of the response, but Copilot and Cowork don't access or use the content of the item in the response.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope: Email and file coverage
claims.claim: Sensitivity-label email protection covers emails sent on or after January 1, 2025.
claims.quote: Emails sent on or after January 1, 2025.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope: Email and file coverage
claims.claim: Calendar invites are not supported by this sensitivity-label protection.
claims.quote: Calendar invites aren't supported.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope; Governance guidance: After rollout; Open questions; rationale
claims.claim: Learn says DLP scans typed prompt text rather than the contents of files uploaded directly into prompts.
claims.quote: DLP can't scan the contents of files that you upload directly into prompts, so evaluation of the uploaded file for sensitive data doesn't occur. DLP only checks the text you type into the prompt itself.

claims.claim: Copilot prompts run in the security context of the user who submits them.
claims.quote: All Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts run in the security context of the user who initiates the prompt.

claims.claim: A user needs permission to access an item before seeing it in a prompt response.
claims.quote: for a user to see an item in a prompt response, they must first have the necessary permissions to access the content of the item.

claims.claim: DLP can exclude items from response processing in addition to the user's existing access permissions.
claims.quote: You can then use the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location feature to exclude items from being processed in the response summary.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Purview Data Security AI Admin is a role that can create or edit policies for this location.
claims.quote: Purview Data Security AI Admin - Role for editing Data Loss Prevention policies related to Copilot and viewing AI content in Data Security Posture Management.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Purview Compliance Administrator is among the roles permitted to create or edit these policies.
claims.quote: Accounts with one of the following roles or role groups can create or edit a DLP policy for the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location: ... Purview Compliance Administrator

claims.claim: The standard Learn about access restrictions link opens Microsoft Learn.
claims.quote: the standard Copilot message includes a Learn about access restrictions link. By default, the link opens Microsoft Learn.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: DLP policy updates can take up to four hours to reach the covered Copilot and Cowork experiences.
claims.quote: Updates to a DLP policy can take up to four hours to reflect in the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork experiences.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Sensitive-information-type and sensitivity-label conditions cannot be combined in the same rule.
claims.quote: You can't use both content contains sensitive info types and content contains sensitivity labels conditions in the same rule.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: A shared policy can contain separate rules for the two condition types.
claims.quote: You can create a rule for each condition in the same policy, but not in the same rule.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The per-user licensing model applies to Purview controls protecting Microsoft 365 assets.
claims.quote: This licensing model enables you to apply Microsoft Purview controls and protections to Microsoft 365 and Windows/macOS endpoint-based assets.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The listed E5/A5, Purview Suite/EDU/FLW, Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Information Protection and Governance, and Office 365 E5/A5 plans include Copilot file and email DLP.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 E5/A5, Microsoft Purview Suite/EDU/FLW and Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5 Information Protection and Governance | Office 365 E5/A5 ... restrict Copilot from processing files and emails | Not included | Not included | Not included | Included | Included

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Prompt DLP is available to all Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat users.
claims.quote: Purview DLP for prompts is available to all users of Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The service description's Copilot DLP licensing table does not separately name Cowork.
claims.quote: DLP for Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat as a location allows organizations to identify and restrict the use of sensitive content in Copilot grounding and Copilot interactions based on sensitive information types and sensitivity labels.

claims.claim: No Cowork-specific entitlement difference for this DLP extension is confirmed in the searched documentation.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Cowork Purview DLP licensing entitlement price meter separate policy location switch exclude Cowork Copilot. Opened the Copilot DLP feature page, Purview service description and Purview billing models; no Cowork-specific DLP entitlement difference found.

claims.claim: The feature page's Licensing section links to Enterprise Plans and Microsoft 365 licensing guidance without specifying its own licence list.
claims.quote:
For information on licensing, see
- Microsoft 365 Enterprise Plans
- Microsoft 365 Service Descriptions

claims.claim: MC1477182 describes no meter or charge for the Cowork DLP extension.
claims.quote: Searched: Read the complete supplied MC1477182 notice, including What and why, Rollout schedule, Impact, Action required and Compliance considerations, for a meter or charge for this DLP extension; none is stated.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: cost; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate meter for the Cowork DLP extension is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Cowork Purview DLP licensing entitlement price meter; "Cowork" "DLP" "billing" "meter". Read Purview billing models, service description and Copilot DLP page. Results identify Cowork usage billing, not a separate charge for extending DLP coverage.

claims.claim: The notice identifies administrators managing Copilot, Cowork and Purview DLP policies as affected.
claims.quote: Administrators who manage Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Cowork, and Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policies.

claims.claim: The notice targets public preview from late September to early October 2026.
claims.quote: Public Preview: Beginning in late September 2026 and expected to complete by early October 2026

claims.where: What's changing; Scope: Dates, Learn and the notice differ
claims.claim: The notice targets worldwide general availability from mid-October to late October 2026.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in mid-October 2026 and expected to complete by late October 2026

claims.claim: Microsoft's end date for the notice is 2026-11-30.
claims.quote: Microsoft's end date 2026-11-30

claims.claim: The notice sets no act-by date.
claims.quote: Act by: none

claims.claim: The combined Copilot location is available only in the Custom policy template.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location is only available in the Custom policy template.

claims.claim: Selecting the combined Copilot location disables all other locations for that policy.
claims.quote: When you select the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location, all other locations for that policy are disabled.

claims.where: Scope: Policy rules; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Policy simulation mode is available for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork.
claims.quote: Policy simulation mode is available for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork.

claims.claim: The combined location supports administrative-unit scoping, including Cowork, alongside tenant-wide policies.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location supports administrative units for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork.

claims.claim: Administrative-unit support for this location is in preview and rolling out, so it may be unavailable in a tenant.
claims.quote: Administrative unit support for this location, including Cowork, is in preview and is rolling out. The option might not yet be available in your tenant.

claims.claim: Policy scoping follows the user submitting the prompt.
claims.quote: DLP policy scoping for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork is based on the user who submits the prompt, not the owner of a file or email that the experience accesses.

claims.claim: The notice recommends informing compliance, security and AI governance stakeholders.
claims.quote: Inform compliance, security, and AI governance stakeholders about this expanded coverage.

claims.claim: The Purview portal path is Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Custom > Custom policy > Locations > Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork.
claims.quote:
Go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy.
Select the Custom template, then Custom policy.
On the Locations page, set the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location to on.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name "<policy name>" -Locations $loc -EnforcementPlanes @("CopilotExperiences") creates the Copilot-location DLP policy.
claims.quote: New-DLPCompliancePolicy -Name "Copilot Policy" -Locations $loc -EnforcementPlanes @("CopilotExperiences")

claims.claim: The reference example creates a Microsoft 365 Copilot DLP policy using sensitivity labels.
claims.quote:
This example creates a DLP policy for Microsoft 365 Copilot in several steps:
- The first command returns information about all sensitivity labels.

claims.claim: The New-DlpCompliancePolicy reference page does not mention Cowork.
claims.quote: Searched: Cowork in the fetched New-DlpCompliancePolicy reference, including its Copilot example and Locations and EnforcementPlanes parameter documentation; no matches.

claims.claim: No separate Cowork switch within the combined Copilot DLP policy location is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Cowork Purview DLP separate policy location switch exclude Cowork Copilot; "Cowork" "DLP" "separate" "configuration". Read Copilot DLP setup, supported actions and admin units, plus New-DlpCompliancePolicy. No separate Cowork-only DLP switch found.

claims.claim: DLP alerts are supported for the combined policy location.
claims.quote: DLP alerts and DLP notifications are supported.

claims.claim: DLP notifications are supported for the combined policy location.
claims.quote: DLP alerts and DLP notifications are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft Entra AI Admin is among the roles that can create or edit policies for this location.
claims.quote: Microsoft Entra AI Admin - Role for managing all aspects of Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI-related enterprise services in Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: Microsoft Entra Global Admin is among the roles that can create or edit policies for this location.
claims.quote: Microsoft Entra Global Admin - Role for managing all aspects of Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft services that use Microsoft Entra identities.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends using roles with the fewest permissions.
claims.quote: Microsoft recommends that you use roles with the fewest permissions.

claims.claim: The DLP extension's sources document no new agent actions, describing policy evaluation of prompts and grounding content instead.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Cowork DLP new agent actions prompt grounding New-DlpCompliancePolicy CopilotExperiences. Read the supplied roadmap and notice, Copilot DLP feature page and policy reference; no new agent action attributed to this DLP extension.

claims.claim: The rationale collectively describes the listed file and email protection plans as E5-tier plans.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 E5/A5, Microsoft Purview Suite/EDU/FLW and Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5 Information Protection and Governance | Office 365 E5/A5
claims.fix: In the cost rationale, replace 'included only in E5-tier plans' with 'included in the plans listed in Cost and licensing'. The table also names suite and frontline plans, so E5-tier should not stand in for the exact entitlement list.
